subject: Acceptance gates & ephemeral testcase escrow for BrightRetail pilot
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: Acceptance gates & ephemeral testcase escrow for BrightRetail pilot

Team —

Putting a short mutual action plan draft together for the BrightRetail pilot exchange. High level ask: BrightRetail will provide a small subset of their customer-facing queries (anonymized) and we will reciprocate with a 200-testcase prompt pack plus a tiny seed dataset for model QA. Key constraints to preserve:

- Ephemeral access: assets are time-limited (30 days) and must be destroyed after the pilot unless a separate license is signed.
- Usage: materials are for model quality assessment / internal eval only; no training or public distribution.
- Escrow & provenance: both parties want an escrow record and a takedown schedule.
- Attestation: BrightRetail requires evidence of destruction (screenshot + md5 manifest).

Attached: redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (draft MAP), promptpack_sample_v2.zip (example), testcase_manifest.csv (proposed index).

Proposed timeline we can offer:
1) 12/10 — send formal MAP to BrightRetail + promptpack sample
2) 12/11 — BrightRetail confirms acceptance or requests edits
3) 12/13 — DocuSign exchanged (if acceptable)
4) 12/15 — dataset transfer and signed ephemeral access token (30-day TTL)
5) 01/14/2027 — automated takedown + attestation delivered to BrightRetail

Questions for you both: any legal language we should avoid in the MAP (training prohibition, narrow rights wording)? Do we want to allow a one-time archival snapshot for debugging (read-only, encrypted) or strictly ephemeral?

Thanks — I can turn this into a send-out mail once we align.

— Priyom
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lily Chen <lily@brightretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood MAP & ephemeral testcase exchange — proposed terms (draft)

Hi Lily —

Nice to meet you via email. Per our call yesterday, attaching a short mutual action plan and a tiny sample of the proposed prompt pack. The MAP is intentionally concise; main points below:

- What we exchange: BrightRetail -> anonymized query set (up to 5k rows) for evaluation only. Redwood -> 200-testcase prompt pack + 10 seed queries.
- Usage constraints: evaluation only; explicit no-training clause; no redistribution outside of named BrightRetail reviewers.
- Access model: ephemeral access tokens (30-day TTL) issued by Redwood Private for the pilot.
- Escrow & takedown: Greenwood (third-party escrow) will record hashes; upon TTL expiry Redwood will delete and deliver a destruction attestation (md5 + system logs).

Attachments: redwood_MAP_v1.pdf; promptpack_sample_v2.zip; testcase_manifest.csv (index).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the above and any edits by EOD 12/11.
2) We circulate a single-page DocuSign for both parties to sign (aim 12/13).
3) Transfer via encrypted S3 presigned link once signed.

If you'd like changes to the access window (e.g., 14-day vs 30-day), let me know — we can be flexible but need to lock TTL before transfer.

Best,
Priyom
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Lily Chen <lily@brightretail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@brightretail.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:27:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & ephemeral testcase exchange — proposed terms (draft)

Thanks Priyom — and thanks for the clear MAP. A few quick points from BrightRetail (ops):

- We appreciate the ephemeral access approach. Can you confirm there is no persistence on backups for the 30-day transfer window? Our Security team will need to see a short backup retention statement.
- For the escrow, can we avoid naming an external escrow vendor (we prefer a minimal-proof approach: automated hash logging + timestamped Drive copy inside a BrightRetail-managed folder)?
- Attestation: MD5 is fine but we also require a signed statement from Redwood that the deletion process ran (a single line signed by the responsible engineer is acceptable).
- Timeline: 30 days is okay; can we shift the start to 12/15 to align with our holiday freeze schedule?

Small edit suggestion: please replace the phrase "no training" with "no model re‑training or fine-tuning on provided assets without explicit additional agreement" — that wording passes our procurement checks.

On acceptance: we can sign the one-page DocuSign on 12/13 provided the MAP incorporates the edits above.

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lily Chen <lily@brightretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Dec 2026 14:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & ephemeral testcase exchange — proposed terms (draft)

Lily —

Thanks for the quick review and the precise edits. We can accommodate all of BrightRetail's asks:

- Backup persistence: confirmed — no long-term backup snapshots will be retained for the transfer objects. Our infra team will run a pre-transfer verification and produce a short backup-retention statement (one paragraph) that we'll attach to DocuSign.
- Escrow approach: happy to use BrightRetail-managed Drive folder for the escrow record. We'll write the MAP to note that the hash log will also be exported to that Drive and that Redwood will not hold the escrow key.
- Attestation: we will provide an automated deletion report (system logs) plus a signed one-line attestation from the engineer on record.
- Wording update: replaced "no training" with the proposed language: "no model re‑training or fine-tuning on provided assets without explicit additional agreement."
- Start date: shifting the pilot start to 12/15 is fine. TTL window will be 12/15–01/14/2027.

Action items:
- I will publish an updated MAP (redwood_MAP_v1a.pdf) and a one-page DocuSign that mirrors the language above by 12/13.
- After signatures, we will provide a presigned encrypted S3 link and an ephemeral access token (30-day TTL).
- Delivery will include testcase_manifest.csv and the promptpack_sample_v2.zip; final list will be the 200 testcases referenced.

Links: DocuSign (provisioning): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/BR-1194-MAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BR-2026-1194
Drive escrow folder (BrightRetail-managed): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPdocs

If that sounds good I'll kick off the DocuSign and loop legal for the one-paragraph backup statement.

— Priyom
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_MAP_v1a.pdf (to be attached to DocuSign), promptpack_sample_v2.zip (final build), testcase_manifest.csv (final manifest)
